---
title: "Example Code Chunk Options"
author: Anthony Di Fiore
date: today
---

# Standard code block

```{r}
x <- 1
print(x)
log(-x)
```

# Exclude source code

```{r}
#| echo: false
x <- 2
print(x)
log(-x)
```

# Exclude output

```{r}
#| eval: false
x <- 3
print(x)
log(-x)
```

# Exclude warnings

```{r}
#| warning: false
x <- 4
print(x)
log(-4)
```

# Suppress everything

```{r}
#| include: false
x <- 5
print(x)
log(-x)
```

# Add a figure

```{r}
#| out-width: "90%"
knitr::include_graphics("img/wanna_see_the_code_2x.png")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| out-width: "4in"
knitr::include_graphics("img/wanna_see_the_code_2x.png")
```
